title: Go Beginner Mock Test 3
description: Comprehensive 50-minute mock examination for Go at beginner level.

questions.prompt: Which code-review warning about modules is valid?

options.text: changing module identity breaks import assumptions
modules define an import path and dependency boundary
initialize and commit go.mod
The runtime automatically repairs the program

questions.explanation: changing module identity breaks import assumptions. Confirm with gofmt, go test, and a focused program.
